title: Game Penetration Tester
description:
Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. We work with leading developers and publishers in the games industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.

We produce high-quality results by constantly staying at the forefront of modern technology and cutting-edge processes and practices. The best of our team are known for their strong initiative, not just in taking care of their day-to-day responsibilities but in helping identify ways to build, grow, and do more in their work.

We’re currently looking for adynamic addition tothe team tohelp work onexciting cybersecurity and development projects for the video games industry. The ideal candidate will work with cross-functional teams todevelop critical products and services for our clients and offer excellent technical support toour teams. Ifyou’re anenthusiastic, motivated, and lateral thinker, our team iswaiting tomeet you!

This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.

Responsibilities

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games.
  • Reverse engineer game binaries and network protocols to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Bypass client-side protections (SSL pinning, anti-cheat, packing/obfuscation).
  • Develop and maintain internal tools and PoCs (C++, Python).
  • 5+ years in penetration testing, reverse engineering or security research.
  • Strong modern C++ and Python experience.
  • Networking: TCP/UDP fundamentals (fragmentation, sequencing, multiplexing) and protocol design/mapping. Experience with Wireshark, mitmproxy and Scapy.
  • Data/crypto basics: endianness, checksums, hashing, encoding, encryption/signing, bitmasks.
  • Serialization: binary formats and var-length encodings.
  • Binary exploitation (practical): crash triage, UAF/OOB/heap/stack, info leaks, ROP/JOP.
  • Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required).
  • Basic web hacking knowledge.

Working knowledge of

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp.
  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
  • The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
  • A competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities

If this sounds interesting to you and you’d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we’d love hear from you.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Gerente de Manutenção
description:
Descrição da empresa

NOSSA MARCA

Surgindo como uma marca pioneira de hospitalidade de luxo francesa em 1964, o Sofitel traz o espírito francês e inspira encontros genuínos e memoráveis nos destinos mais desejados do mundo

Combinando de forma harmoniosa a cultura local com a energia francesa pela vida, através de um savoir-faire excepcional e serviço generoso, o Sofitel é para viajantes de espírito livre e apreciadores das artes e da cultura que valorizam um sentido refinado e discreto de luxo moderno.

SOFITEL IPANEMA

Sofitel, referência global em hospitalidade de luxo francesa, anuncia a transformação do Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema em seu primeiro hotel flagship no Brasil, com abertura prevista para o final de 2026.

Localizado na Praia de Ipanema, o hotel contará com 172 apartamentos e representará a visão contemporânea da marca sobre luxo, serviço e experiência.

Faça partelo do time de talentos que dará vida a este novo ícone da hotelaria de luxo no Brasil.

Descrição da vaga

O Gerente de Manutenção atuará como o engenheiro responsável pelo hotel, liderando a equipe de manutenção e prestadores de serviços. Essa posição hands‑on garante a operação eficiente do departamento, mantendo os mais altos padrões de qualidade, segurança e excelência.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerenciar e liderar a equipe de Manutenção, coordenando tarefas diárias de técnicos, analistas, coordenadores e prestadores de serviços externos;
  • Atuar ativamente na pré‑abertura do hotel, assegurando que todos os sistemas, operações e padrões de qualidade estejam prontos para inauguração;
  • Planejar, supervisionar e executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos sistemas elétricos, hidráulicos, de climatização e estrutura civil;
  • Garantir segurança operacional, continuidade das atividades e conformidade regulatória do hotel;
  • Coordenar obras e reformas junto ao time de Projetos, assegurando execução dentro do prazo, orçamento e padrões de qualidade;
  • Implementar e gerenciar sistemas de qualidade, requisição de manutenção (chamados) e controle de pedidos em todas as áreas do hotel;
  • Registrar e analisar consumo de utilidades e sistemas do hotel, reportando os resultados;
  • Contribuir com as normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Sustentabilidade, inspecionando áreas e tomando ações corretivas junto ao time, quando necessário;
  • Atuar ativamente para gerar um impacto positivo do hotel no meio ambiente, implementando iniciativas sustentáveis que promovam a economia de água e energia, garantindo simultaneamente a excelência do serviço e o conforto dos hóspedes;
  • Propor de forma proativa soluções e investimentos necessários para reduzir o consumo de água e geração de resíduos do hotel.

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (obrigatório);
  • Pós‑graduação em Engenharia de Manutenção, Facilities, Gestão de Operações/Projetos;
  • Experiência sólida em liderança em manutenção, preferencialmente em hotelaria de luxo;
  • Vivência em pré‑abertura de hotéis ou resorts de alto padrão;
  • Conhecimento sólido em manutenção predial, sistemas prediais, gestão de obras e fornecedores;
  • Experiência com sistemas e softwares de manutenção;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, liderança e organização;
  • Inglês fluente / Francês será um diferencial;
  • Responsabilidade, confiabilidade e senso de urgência.

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from 'Bronze' (Raw) to 'Silver' (Cleaned) and 'Gold' (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\u2019t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sr
description:
Job description

A área de engenharia de dados é deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da Vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e time visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados otimização de processos.

Main responsibilities

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados. Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com engenharia de dados ou funções similares.
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz (tableau, power bi e/ou looker).
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem.
  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager, DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados).
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados.
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .

  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.

  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimization by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.

The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA’s and regional sustainability standards.

The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.

description:
Position is Remote (Canada, or Latin / South America)

No agencies please

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine company that empowers individuals to achieve their physical and cognitive peak through precision telehealth care. We are a high-growth, profitable company tailored to ambitious people who refuse to settle for average. We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.

You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that’s just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners.

  • Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.

  • Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.

  • Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.

  • Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.

  • Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.

  • Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.

Qualifications

  • Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.

  • Demand Gen / YouTube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.

  • Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).

  • Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.
  • Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.

World-Class Benefits

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility.
  • Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.
  • Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people's health and wellness.
  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities.
  • Full Suite Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance (for US & Canada based candidates only).
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees).
  • Liquidity of options whenever available.

Job description

Will You Be There ? O lema aqui é planejar, apresentar soluções, evoluir e crescer. Buscamos profissionais que se envolvam, sejam proativos e se interessem por cada detalhe dos nossos projetos e, acima de tudo, que queiram crescer e dar o seu melhor, todos os dias. O nosso crescimento é constante e sabemos que vamos longe porque acreditamos em tudo que gera movimento. E você? Quer ir mais longe com a gente? Conheça nossos clientes, veja nossos conteúdos e descubra se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte do #WeAreMDS.

Buscamos um profissional responsável por dar suporte operacional e administrativo nas rotinas de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST), com foco no eSocial, realizando atividades administrativas e sistêmicas por meio do sistema SOC, a fim de apoiar o correto envio dos eventos de SST ao governo, conforme prazos e exigências legais.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a parametrização da base do cliente no sistema SOC, seguindo orientações técnicas, procedimentos internos e propostas de serviço definidas, garantindo que as informações estejam organizadas e aptas para utilização no processo de mensageria do eSocial.
  • Realiza a conferência e validação administrativa dos cadastros e informações de SST inseridos no sistema, verificando a consistência dos dados e sinalizando inconsistências à supervisão ou às áreas responsáveis, com o objetivo de apoiar a conformidade das informações utilizadas no envio dos eventos governamentais.
  • Realizar a emissão de relatórios no sistema SOC, apoiando a auditoria das informações lançadas, a identificação de pendências e a organização dos dados necessários para correções, sempre sob orientação da equipe técnica ou da liderança da área.
  • Atuar no apoio à interface entre áreas internas, supervisão e cliente, realizando solicitações de dados, acompanhando retornos e organizando informações pendentes, a fim de contribuir para que os eventos de SST sejam enviados ao eSocial dentro dos prazos legais.
  • Presta suporte administrativo à gestão de SST, auxiliando no relacionamento operacional com a empresa-cliente por meio do envio de relatórios, registros de recibos e atualização de status dos envios, garantindo rastreabilidade, organização e controle das informações.
  • Apoiar a formalização mensal da conclusão da mensageria dos eventos de SST, organizando relatórios e registros no sistema SOC, de modo a assegurar o histórico das transmissões e a comprovação do envio das informações ao governo.
  • Realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme necessidade e/ou demanda da área, sempre que necessário, por meio de treinamento, qualificação profissional e orientações do líder imediato, a fim de garantir o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Desejável estar cursando ensino superior (Administração, Comércio exterior, Engenharia de produção e/ou Logística);
  • Conhecimento básico no pacote office;
  • Experiência na área administrativa;
  • Diferencial: conhecimento em Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST); mensageria de eventos do eSocial;
  • Ótimo relacionamento interpessoal, resiliência, organização, flexibilidade e comprometimento.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Sênior| Supply Chain
description:
Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Sênior| Supply Chain

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional para garantir o cumprimento das metas através da comercialização de produtos e serviços TOTVS com um processo que permita buscar um suspect, compreender suas necessidades, apresentar produtos e serviços, gerar oportunidades, propor, adequar, vender e entregar soluções, sempre mantendo um contínuo relacionamento técnico e empresarial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do AR nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Prospectar novos negócios na base instalada e/ou em novos clientes, visando ampliar Market Share TOTVS (Hunter);
  • Planejar e executar o plano tático alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da DRG e resultados de vendas no segmento/região de atuação;
  • Ser especialista e liderar o assunto no seu negócio, sendo capaz de estabelecer discursos e formas de atuação altamente adequadas ao perfil de cada cliente/prospect/segmento;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas individuais e metas de venda do time do Comercial em que estiver atuando, de acordo com a estratégia da TOTVS;
  • Visitar e assistir a base instalada e os novos clientes, garantindo sempre a excelência do atendimento TOTVS e buscando recorrentemente novos negócios;
  • Atender e se relacionar com o mercado e com a base instalada, através de visitas, reuniões, contatos telefônicos e e-mails;
  • Planejar, executar e liderar o processo de vendas de um produto ou serviço TOTVS ao mercado;
  • Levantar e analisar as informações do negócio, compilar e montar um plano de trabalho apoiado pela metodologia de vendas TOTVS;
  • Registrar no CRM e comunicar a área de Estratégia Comercial/Operações e Segmentos, informações relevantes sobre mercado/carteira;
  • Atuar como facilitador para a solução das demandas dos clientes e prospects;
  • Realizar a interface com as áreas internas da TOTVS;
  • Entregar e acompanhar a entrega dos produtos e/ou serviços TOTVS, garantindo que os acordos sejam cumpridos e os objetivos atendidos;
  • Realizar pós-venda com o objetivo de garantir o atendimento e gerar novas oportunidades (Cross Sell e Up Sell);
  • Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Ser referência técnica e comercial no seu segmento de atuação;
  • Exercer liderança informal na equipe, apoiando diretamente a gestão formal da empresa;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de executivos com alto nível de performance, atuando como buddy para novos TOTVERs;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência com vendas B2B de software de tecnologia e ERP;
  • Perfil Hunter, de prospecção de novos negócios;
  • Familiaridade com segmento de Supply Chain.
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para TOTVERS e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

Sobre a empresa

Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance. Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente! Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes. Vem com a gente inovar e construir o futuro da tecnologia. #VemPraTOTVS #SomosTOTVS

description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua desde 1932 no Brasil e faz parte do Grupo multinacional Roemmers, com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina.

No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atua em dois segmentos: medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1.500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história por meio de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

CASO VOCÊ:

  • Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis
  • Possua visão orientada a dados
  • Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita
  • Tenha bom planejamento do tempo
  • Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira...

Seu lugar é aqui!

REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Domínio de SAP PWCE e sistemas de comércio exterior.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Incoterms, regimes aduaneiros especiais, classificação fiscal e logística internacional.
  • Inglês avançado (fluente para negociações e leitura de documentos técnicos) e Espanhol intermediário desejável.
  • Experiência em operações de importação/exportação, com atuação em empresas de médio ou grande porte.

QUAIS SERÃO AS SUAS RESPONSIBILIDADES?

Responsável por garantir o abastecimento estratégico de insumos, produtos e materiais importados, conduzindo operações de comércio exterior com foco em eficiência, compliance e otimização de custos. Atua como referência técnica na área, liderando iniciativas de melhoria contínua e assegurando a conformidade com os padrões regulatórios e de qualidade da FQM.

E AS ATIVIDADES?

  • Gerenciar processos completos de importação e exportação, desde a negociação com fornecedores até o desembaraço aduaneiro.
  • Realizar cotações internacionais, análise de viabilidade logística e negociação de contratos com fornecedores e agentes externos.
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos de comércio exterior (invoice, packing list, certificados, contratos), assegurando conformidade legal e regulatória.
  • Conduzir reuniões estratégicas com fornecedores internacionais para alinhamento de prazos, qualidade e condições comerciais.
  • Monitorar e controlar pagamentos de impostos, taxas e numerários, garantindo a regularidade fiscal e documental das operações.
  • Prospectar e homologar novos fornecedores internacionais, conduzindo testes e análises técnicas de insumos e produtos.
  • Acompanhar e interpretar mudanças na legislação aduaneira e regulatória, propondo ajustes nos processos internos.
  • Atuar como ponto de apoio técnico para áreas internas, contribuindo com análises e soluções em temas de comércio exterior.
  • Utilizar sistemas ERP (SAP PWCE) e plataformas governamentais (SISCOMEX, Radar) para gestão das operações.

Overview

UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world’s best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez’s Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people’s lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it!

Responsibilities

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

This is a contract position. Up to 40 hours weekly. Remote. Selection Process

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

title: Senior Manager, Service Delivery FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and implement a fit for purpose integrated support model (including FIFA, technology partners, service providers, government entities etc.) across all phases of the project.
  • Management / implementation of IT Service management processes and procedures including the management of the ITSM tool.
  • Establish service level agreements (SLAs) in accordance with the FIFA Technology Handbook across all technology services.
  • Be the lead manager for Service Delivery area within the FWWC27 Technology Project team
  • Recruitment of direct reports in the next phase of hiring & contracting, who will in turn be responsible to deliver their key area of scope.
  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.
  • Ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed to scope, within budget and on schedule.
  • Continuously review and make recommendations to improve technology across the tournament.
  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organizational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

Your profile

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical skills and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team Player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • ITIL foundations
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands‑on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You’ll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast‑scaling e‑commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You’ll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross‑channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.
  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:

Localização: Duque de Caxias, RJ, BR,

Cidade : Duque de Caxias Estado : Rio de Janeiro (BR-RJ) País : Brasil (BR) Número da Vaga : 43486

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Consolidar relacionamento com clientes, prestando consultoria, através de cursos, treinamentos e visitas técnicas, oferecendo soluções inovadoras que agreguem praticidade e qualidade, novas receitas e trocas de informações sobre a aplicação dos produtos Bunge.
  • Seguir o roteiro e realizar as visitas estabelecidasaos clientes, utilizando técnicas de demonstração das vantagens do produto, de acordo com o planejamento estabelecido por local, região dentre outros, apresentando os materiais promocionais, receitas e os benefícios dos produtos.
  • Prestar serviços, assessoria e consultoria para a valorização dos produtos dos clientes e consolidar a parceria da empresa no mercado de alimentação.
  • Preparar as receitas nos clientes para demonstração das vantagens do produto, de acordo com exigências de qualidade, apresentação e sabor, bem como balanceamento nutricional.
  • Testar os produtos da empresa, comparando com a concorrência, identificando os diferenciais, qualidade e buscando subsídios para agregar valor com clientes na utilização de nossos produtos.
  • Realizar e reportar comparativo entre produtos Bunge e concorrentes com inspeções de qualidade no ponto de venda.
  • Preparar a participação em eventos e feiras, executando a organização do local, efetuando a pré-prepararão de preparação de receitas, produtos e outros para as demonstrações programadas.
  • Atuar na divulgação aos clientes do embasamento teórico e técnico das receitas, insumos, procedimentos, higiene, limpeza e outros, orientando nas normas e procedimentos de boas práticas alimentares.
  • Realizar a requisição de produtos e insumos para utilização na produção das receitas, providenciando as condições adequadas para evitar a deterioração e perdas, efetuando o controle do estoque com verificação constante da validade dos produtos.
  • Manter bom relacionamento com responsáveis dos clientes (proprietários, diretores, gerentes, compradores e outros conforme abrangência do cliente), visando fidelizar e conseguir maior utilização dos produtos na preparação dos alimentos.
  • Atuar como elo entre os responsáveis pelos clientes e as equipes de vendas, informando-os sobre necessidades identificadas, produtos complementares e outros para incrementar a participação no mercado.
  • Preparar relatório das ocorrências diariamente, bem como efetuar levantamento e acompanhamento da prática dos concorrentes.
  • Organizar e divulgar ações informativas para o público leigo, consultórios ou empresas, para promover os conceitos de saúde e qualidade de vida defendidos pela empresa.
  • Lançar no sistema informatizado, após a realização das visitas, detalhes do contato com o cliente, reportando objetivo, ocorrências, necessidades evidenciadas e observações relevantes.

Experiências e conhecimentos esperados

  • Curso técnico completo na área de Panificação e/ou Tecnologia de Alimentos.
  • Experiência prévia no setor de panificação, preferencialmente em ambiente industrial.
  • Experiência em atendimento e relacionamento com clientes no contexto industrial ou comercial.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de fermentação natural, produção de pizzas, confeitaria e massas folhadas, será considerado um diferencial.
  • Proficiência intermediária no Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Local de trabalho: Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Na Bunge, nosso objetivo é conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustível essenciais para o mundo. Como uma fornecedora líder de soluções para o agronegócio, nossa equipe de aproximadamente 37.000 colaboradores dedicados atua em parceria com agricultores ao redor do mundo para movimentar commodities agrícolas de onde são produzidas para onde são necessárias — de maneira mais rápida, inteligente e eficiente. Somos uma empresa líder mundial em originação, armazenamento, distribuição, além de processamento e refino de oleaginosas, oferecendo um amplo portfólio de óleos, gorduras e proteínas de origem vegetal. Atuamos lado a lado com nossos clientes em ambas as pontas da cadeia de valor para fornecer produtos de qualidade e desenvolver soluções inovadoras e personalizadas que atendam às necessidades em constante evolução dos consumidores. Com mais de 200 anos de experiência e presença em mais de 50 países, temos o compromisso de fortalecer a segurança alimentar global, promover a sustentabilidade e contribuir para a prosperidade das comunidades onde operamos. A Bunge tem sede registrada em Genebra, Suíça, e sua sede corporativa está localizada em St. Louis, Missouri, EUA. Saiba mais em bunge.com.br.

Diariamente, nossos profissionais incorporam os valores que são a essência da Bunge:

  • SOMOS UM SÓ TIME – Colaborativo, respeitoso e inclusivo
  • LIDERAMOS O CAMINHO – Somos ágeis, Empoderados e inovadores
  • FAZEMOS O QUE É CERTO – Com segurança, de forma sustentável e com integridade

Reconhecemos que nosso sucesso depende da variedade de perspectivas que cada um de nossos colaboradores agrega à Bunge. Estamos empenhados em promover práticas para nutrir uma cultura de pertencimento para todos. Globalmente, apoiamos os Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres, de ONU Mulheres. No Brasil, somos associados ao Mover - Movimento pela Equidade Racial, e fomos eleitos pela ferramenta global Disability Index Report® como um dos melhores locais para se trabalhar em relação à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência. Atuamos continuamente em prol de nosso compromisso de deixar um legado positivo em todas as comunidades onde atuamos.

Se você se identifica com esses valores, junte-se a nós! Valorizamos e investimos em pessoas que acreditam em nosso propósito e o vivenciam com entusiasmo a cada dia – pessoas que têm #OrgulhodeSerBunge

description:
Job description

Quem Somos?

Você sabia que somos a construtora de maior valorização na bolsa de valores em 2025?

E temos mais de 3 mil Profissionais Cury que diariamente são movidos pelo desafio de realizar o sonho de milhões de brasileiros: a aquisição da casa própria.

Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos, seja na cadeia produtiva ou na comercialização dos empreendimentos.

Gostou? Prazer, somos a Cury, venha fazer parte da nossa história!

Conheça as nossas etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Inscrição em nossa plataforma e seleção dos currículos
  • Análise dos testes de acordo com o perfil da vaga
  • Bate-papo com o time de R&S
  • Bate-papo com o Gestor da vaga
  • Feedback da sua candidatura

Obs: essas etapas podem sofrer alterações de acordo com a necessidade da vaga.

Ah... pessoas com deficiências são super bem-vindas viu?

Acredita que não preenche todos os requisitos?

Um estudo recente do LinkedIn indicou que mulheres são menos propensas a se candidatarem a vagas se não acreditarem que preenchem 100% das qualificações. Em comparação, homens tendem a se inscrever mesmo atendendo 60%. Aqui na Cury, queremos construir um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais diverso e inclusivo. Abaixo estão listadas as responsabilidades e atribuições para posição, porém, se você acredita que sua experiência prévia não se alinha exatamente com todos os pré-requisitos, te incentivamos a se candidatar de qualquer maneira caso tenha se identificado com a posição. Você pode ser a pessoa certa e não queremos perder a chance de te conhecer.

Você curtiu? Estamos aguardando a sua candidatura!

Main responsibilities

  • Estudar e conhecer toda documentação do empreendimento (licenças, viabilidades, termos de compromisso, contratos de financiamento, projetos legais e memoriais de incorporação)

  • Acompanhar junto ao Engenheiro de Produção, ao Mestre de Obras e aos encarreg todos os serviços executados no canteiro de obras, desde o início até sua conclusão e aprovação.
  • Acompanhar e avaliar os serviços de subempreiteiros e terceirizados. Relatar aos setores responsáveis para que sejam cumpridas as cláusulas contratuais. Validar as medições de subempreiteiros e terceirizados
  • Avaliar a necessidade de contratações, transferências, demissões e reclassificações dos colaboradores da obra
  • Identificar necessidades de treinamento e reciclagem das equipes de trabalho. Ministrar ou solicitar treinamentos conforme as normas e procedimentos da empresa
  • Assegurar o andamento da obra de acordo com o cronograma proposto
  • Acompanhar e indicar ajustes do cronograma físico-financeiro da obra, conforme necessidade
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e medicina do trabalho pelos colaboradores
  • Cobrar ao Engenheiro de Produção, Mestre de Obras e Encarregado
  • Analisar, implantar e monitorar o Plano de Gerenciamento de Resíduos da Construção Civil (PGRCC) e condicionantes ambientais do empreendimento
  • Elaborar e aprovar o diário de obras
  • Administrar e prestar contas do caixa da obra (recurso disponível para pequenas despesas não previstas)
  • Fornecer informações sobre o andamento da obra ao setor de Planejamento e Controle da empresa. Participar das reuniões de Planejamento Físico e Financeiro da obra

  • Bolo no pote para comemorar os aniversariantes do mês
  • Confraternização fim do ano com diversas premiações

Nossos Valores
