title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Technical Services Senior Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores — Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta — a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que têm ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future, um programa voltado para profissionais com forte perfil comercial, que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e desejam atuar como assessores de investimentos.

Na XP Inc., você contará com suporte completo para obter a certificação CPA-20, integrar‑se à nova função e aprofundar seus conhecimentos sobre produtos de investimento. O programa oferece uma trilha sólida de carreira para que, em um ano, você se torne um assessor no segmento Alta Renda da XP.

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré‑requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn.

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.

O Que Procuramos

Pré‑requisitos

  • Graduação completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência em vendas (diferencial: prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Interesse pelo mercado de investimentos;

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é um pool de talentos, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco mais do que outras vagas da XP! Para outras oportunidades, acesse: Oportunidades XP Inc.

Saúde e bem‑estar

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • Plano odontológico
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Zenklub
  • Seguro de Vida
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Vale Transporte
  • New Value (clube de benefícios)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Fundos de Investimentos Exclusivos
  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

JOB PURPOSE:

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) serves as the operational and administrative anchor of the Office of the Dean and is the primary front-facing representative for the College of Arts & Sciences. Reporting to the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, this role is responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, front office services, facilities coordination, vendor and procurement activities, and student staff supervision to ensure a professional, efficientated Dean’s Office.

    This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

    Front Office & Executive Operations

    • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
    • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
    • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office

    Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

    • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
    • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
    • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
    • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

    Student & Administrative Support Oversight

    • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination

    Facilities & Building Operations

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean

    • Strong vendor coordination and procurement management skills

O profissional será responsável por executar atividades que exigem energia e disposição física, garantindo a manutenção, conservação e limpeza das áreas comuns do condomínio. Deverá zelar pelas instalações, assegurando que estejam sempre limpas, organizadas e em boas condições de uso.

title: Analista de Tesouraria Pleno Rio de Janeiro - RJ and Hybrid Full-time employee
description:
Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a GreatPlacetoWork.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupominorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Elaborar, analisar e acompanhar o fluxo de caixa diário, semanal e mensal;
  • Controlar e executar as operações financeiras diárias, como pagamentos, transferências, aplicações e resgates de investimentos sempre em parceria com a Asset do Grupo;
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias diárias, assegurando a identificação das movimentações;
  • Interagir com instituições financeiras para temas operacionais e financeiros, como contratações de linhas de crédito, convênios de cobranças, pagamentos, conciliações, atualizações cadastrais anuais, abertura e encerramento de contas, negociações de tarifas, investimentos etc;

description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. The candidate will play a key role in the development and execution of pre-sales activities for geomodelling workflows, with deep expertise in SKUA, RMS, and subsurface characterization.

  • Provide advanced technical support and consulting in Aspen SKUA and Aspen RMS geomodelling software.
  • Prepare, present, and propose workflows for structural modeling, property modeling, seismic interpretation integration, reservoir characterization, and uncertainty analysis.
  • Search, uncover, understand, and analyze client/prospect needs and requirements to grow or penetrate accounts.
  • Conduct technical presentations and demonstrations on the AspenTech SSE subsurface applications suite, with emphasis on SKUA and RMS.
  • Present integrated workflows combining geomodelling software with other tools in the AspenTech suite (e.g., seismic interpretation, petrophysics, flow simulation).
  • Conduct pilot projects showcasing geomodelling workflows, demonstrating differentiators of SKUA/RMS versus equivalent market solutions.

  • Run advanced demonstrations and presentations at customer sites, workshops, and trade shows.

  • Develop relationships with users through personal contact, onsite engagements, and user group meetings.
  • Communicate with product managers and developers on issues identified from field observations and customer feedback.
  • Training – Deliver high-quality basic and advanced training on geomodelling workflows and modules within SKUA and RMS.
  • Support – Provide troubleshooting and advanced user assistance; own issues until resolution or appropriate escalation. Demonstrate proficiency with internal support procedures and tracking systems.
  • Professional Development – Continue to actively develop technical expertise in geomodelling methodologies, reservoir characterization, and integrated subsurface workflows. Seek opportunities for personal development of non-technical competencies.
  • Technical Reporting – Complete and submit Consultant Activity Reports after each project in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to R&D and Product Management to contribute to continued improvement of our geoscience solutions.

  • BS in Geology, Reservoir Engineering, or related subsurface discipline; MS preferred with more than 5–7 years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of geomodeling, reservoir characterization, structural modeling, property modeling, and uncertainty workflows.
  • Experience working with complex geological settings such as carbonates, unconventionals, tight sands, salt tectonics, and structurally complex reservoirs.
  • Expertise in handling subsurface datasets: seismic interpretations, well logs, geological maps, core data, and reservoir simulation grids.
  • Capable of conducting high-quality basic and advanced classroom training on SKUA and RMS modules and workflows.

  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team when required.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor younger professionals.
  • Able to interact effectively with other departments and multidisciplinary colleagues.
  • Strong commitment to deadlines and customer satisfaction.
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural business environment.
  • Flexible – must be able to travel.

title: Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing
description:
Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Retail & Licensing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Commercial Operations team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Head of Licensing & Retail and other key individuals responsible for delivering Licensing & Retail efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source, manage licensing domestic partners in coordination, collaboration and liaison with the FIFA Licensing & Retail (L&R) team in Zurich and aligned with the overall global L&R strategy to ensure the presence of a comprehensive, commercial and compelling range of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ licensed products in Brazil.
  • Develop and implement a national strategic licensing & retail plan in consultation and with approval of FIFA Licensing & Retail team in Zurich and aligned with the global Licensing Strategy. This will include planning product assortment, pricing, and distribution channels to maximize revenue and brand exposure in line with the overall Strategy for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA Licensing, Legal, Financial and Commercial Guidelines working with internal stakeholders.
  • Oversee the implementation and manage the approval of all brand executions (licensed products, packaging, pos, etc.).
  • Manage and oversee the production, quality control, and timely delivery of licensed products coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors.
  • Analyse market trends, consumer behaviours, and competitor activities to identify new licensing and retail opportunities and optimize sales potential.
  • Manage relationships with retail partners, including brick-and-mortar stores, online platforms, and official FIFA Stores, ensuring brand consistency and driving sales growth.
  • Monitor and analyse sales performance, inventory levels, and consumer feedback to make data-driven decisions and implement corrective actions if needed.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Legal and Brand Protection to enforce licensing agreements, protect intellectual property rights, and prevent unauthorized use of FIFA trademarks.
  • Provide regular reports and presentations on Licensing & retail activities, including sales performance, market insights, and recommendations for improvement, to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Work with the relevant teams in the Brazil entity to stay informed on key milestones, activations, local and domestic implementations.
  • Oversee royalty reporting, ensure timely payment of remuneration and report back to L&R team in HOF.
  • Manage the contract management process via FIFA’s online system (BrandComply) and ensure the licensees adhere to this process.
  • Assist the L&R team in Zurich with the selection and appointment of retail concessionaires.

Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of work experience in licensing and/or event retail in Brazil with preference in the sports or entertainment industry. At least 3 years’ experience leading a team.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Thorough knowledge Brazilian market, retail, consumer products and sports and entertainment trends
  • Excellent understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models
  • Positive and can-do attitude
  • Strategic thinker whilst tactical implementor
  • Highly organised and with a structured approach
  • Financial and legal understanding
  • Comfortable working in a cross-cultural and cross functional team
  • Stress resilient and used to working to tight deadlines.
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel retail
  • Understanding of complex stakeholder rights models

Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the 'Control Room' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s 'Visualizations' and that the 'Data Pipelines' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

About the Role

We are looking for a QA Analyst (Manual Testing) to ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of web-based applications through thorough manual testing practices.   • Collaborate closely with developers and product teams to clarify issues and validate fixes.
  • Ensure testing activities align with the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Maintain clear and accurate testing documentation.

Must Have

  • Previous experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on manual testing.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

  • Familiarity with bug‑tracking and test‑management tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile application testing.

  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum environments.

  • Control no-shows, flight delays, and operational deviations, ensuring timely communication to stakeholders.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. description:
About Nu

Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

People and Culture at Nubank

Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank´s culture.

We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders.

You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values.

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

As a Senior Recruiter, you’re expected to:

  • Own and drive full-cycle recruitment
  • Build strong, consultative partnerships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and advising on best hiring practices.
  • Source and engage passive candidates through creative channels and market research.
  • Deliver high-touch candidate experiences that reflect Nubank’s values of transparency, empathy, and simplicity.
  • Use data and metrics to inform recruiting strategies and continuously improve pipeline health and process efficiency.
  • Partner with employer branding, people analytics, and HR teams to align hiring efforts with business goals.

You will be a great fit if you have:

  • Experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in fast-paced, product-driven companies.
  • A strong understanding of the talent landscape, especially in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple searches and stakeholders with a solutions-oriented approach.
  • Experience with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, etc.).
  • Passion for candidate experience, inclusive hiring, and employer brand.
  • Advanced English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Previous exposure to fintech or hypergrowth environments.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

We’re continuously building our pool of exceptional online teachers across the following curricula:

  • US Diploma / Advanced Placement
  • Primary and LEAP

This role offers a flexible, fully remote teaching setup, allowing you to create high-quality, personalised learning experiences from home and at a schedule that works for you. You’ll be teaching in a premium one-on-one environment, supported by our full suite of curriculum-aligned resources.

If you’re passionate about student growth and excited by the idea of working with learners from around the world, we invite you to express your interest. Please submit your CV and we’ll be in touch when a suitable opportunity becomes available.

  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.

Required Qualifications

title: Senior Fraud Auditor- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Overview

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

We are seeking a Fraud Investigator to join the Internal Special Audits Division.

The Internal Special Audits Division is responsible for conducting highly sensitive investigations into issues involving fraud, conflicts of interest, waste, and abuse to provide the management and the Board of Directors with reports, analyses, recommendations, and information concerning the activities reviewed. The Special Audits Division also helps addressing fraud risk management across the Company with programs of awareness, policy and risk consulting, and proactive risk mitigation measures.

Your primary role is to conduct confidential investigations involving misconduct by employees and contractors, while seeking to identify and develop relevant facts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead or support time-sensitive investigations.
  • Become familiar with and utilize data mining and analytical techniques to both identify potential fraud and gather corroborating evidence to support investigations.
  • Become familiar with and utilize Enterprise Risk Management tools (i.e., SAP) to obtain data in support of investigations.
  • Provide fraud awareness presentations throughout the Company to varying job specialties and levels of management.
  • Liaise and coordinate with other fraud-related stakeholder departments including Corporate Security, Law, Personnel and Labor Relations.
  • Draft timely investigative reports and verbally communicate results.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Work independently yet effectively within a team of experienced professionals
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor degree in accounting, finance, human resources, law, criminology, compliance, computer. an advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of experience in forensic accounting, fraud investigation, auditing, law enforcement, compliance, or a related field where you utilized and developed expert interviewing and investigative techniques.
  • You will have at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • You must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with solid presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be able to quickly evaluating allegations of fraud, abuse and conflicts of interest and determine the violation of the law, regulations, or Company policy.
  • You should have effective and modern investigative techniques to quickly unravel, explain, and report complicated fraud and conflicts of interest schemes.
  • You should be able analyze facts and evidence and form evidence-based conclusions concerning violations of the law, regulations, or Company policy.

Working environment

title: Brazil - RJ - Rio de Janeiro: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

About the team

The sourcing team is the engine behind Nu’s leadership growth. We are responsible for identifying and engaging the architects of our future. Our focus is on Executive (C-level, VP, Director) and Enterprise/Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Compliance, and Business Development), driving efficiency through:

  • Executive Market Intelligence: Mapping the global landscape of leadership talent and understanding the movement of high-level executives across the FinTech and Enterprise sectors.

  • Strategic Market Mapping: Identifying specialized "hunting grounds" for corporate excellence and creating exclusive, diverse talent pools of high-impact passive candidates.

In this position, you will:

  • Target Executive Talent: Identify, map, and engage senior leaders and specialized corporate professionals capable of navigating complex, regulated global environments.
  • Advise Senior Stakeholders: Act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, providing data-driven insights to influence hiring decisions and organizational design.
  • Master Personalized Outreach: Craft bespoke, highly professional engagement strategies for passive executive talent, ensuring a premium candidate experience from the first touchpoint.
  • Execute Global Mappings: Build robust market maps and cluster data on competitors and peer companies to identify top-tier talent in Finance, Legal, Operations, and other Enterprise functions.
  • Manage Complexity: Balance the urgency of corporate needs with the discretion and long-term relationship-building required for executive-level recruitment.
  • Drive Diversity at the Top: Proactively build diverse leadership pipelines, ensuring Nu’s executive layer reflects the diversity of our global customer base.

Requirements:

  • Proven Experience: Solid background in Executive Search or Corporate/Enterprise Sourcing (Finance, Legal, G&A, or Business functions) on a global scale.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to communicate and build rapport with high-level stakeholders and C-suite candidates.
  • Analytical Rigor: Proficiency in using market data, compensation trends, and talent mapping tools to build autonomous strategies for leadership pipelines.
  • Discretion & Influence: Ability to handle confidential information and influence senior decision-makers in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Fluent English: Essential for global collaboration and executive engagement across regions.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.

Diversity & Inclusion

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

Role Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.
  • Strong communication skills, with assertiveness to raise operational gaps and collaborate across functions to solve them.
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, with proven results in bringing quality insights into actionable interventions (training, KB updates, process/system refinements).
  • Certifications like Six Sigma / Black Belt or Enablement experience are a plus.

Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. Reports to

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Uniforms Senior Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for full project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout
  • Develop the operational plan, setting up affiliated systems, identify functional distribution spaces, engage with stakeholders, contract local suppliers to deliver the FWWC2027 uniform programme, across all the Uniforms Distribution Centers
  • Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations
  • Recruit and effectively train and manage the uniforms team (both workforce and volunteers) during planning and delivery periods ensuring best practices are clearly defined and the service level provided across all Uniform Distribution Centers is consistent
  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms
  • Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.

Your Profile

Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Uniform Management; preferably with experience in mega (sports) events and corporate organisations
  • Excellent people manager, motivating, inspiring and seeing results through others
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)
  • Strong written and oral communication
  • Proven track record in administering uniform projects across complex quantity structures
  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence, with a pragmatic approach to solving problems
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities
  • Demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Experience

  • Previous experience in a similar position.
  • Previous work in a multinational oil company is desirable.
  • Experience with crew logistics management, including scheduling, mobilizations, travel arrangements, accommodation, and documentation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with logistics operations, such as travel bookings, vendor coordination, cost control, and operational support.
  • Experience using travel management systems and tools related to personnel logistics.

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team. As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Must Have

  • Familiarity with SQL databases and ORM tools
  • Understanding of cloud services and deployment strategies

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • Self-starter capable of working independently across the stack

Nice to Have

  • Experience with authentication systems (Better Auth, SSO)

Home office; Competitive compensation based on experience; Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company; International Projects; Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational); Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass; Games and Competitions;

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Partnership Development Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

The position

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

HPC Engineer Role

HPC is an important and technically challenging compute domain, with specialised tooling and a very high expectation of precision, efficiency and automation. This role is for a software engineer to join our HPC team to deliver an outstanding HPC experience – from bare metal to public cloud – as part of the broader Ubuntu platform. We are looking for a range of skills and experience, and will work on everything from the kernel to Debian packaging, but the heart of our effort will be Python software development for automation of key software in the HPC sphere. Ideally, you should have some experience of high performance computing environments and a desire to unlock HPC for the world.

Familiarity with HPC hardware and software is also a strong advantage – delivering great experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, Singularity and related technologies will be central to this team’s work. title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with you and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

  • Demonstrates creativity, foresight, and mature engineering judgment in anticipating and solving engineering problems during the development and application of new and improved products and processes.
  • Establishes best practices that incorporate Reliability, Health, Safety, and Environment concepts to guide others in analysis and design.
  • Evaluates proposed theoretical results to meet design requirements.
  • Serves as a technical expert to other employees to solves complex system equations and develops custom equations to simplify complex problems by using advanced engineering tools.
  • Serves as a technical expert by coaching, developing, and reviewing work from other employees.
  • Possesses excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross- disciplinary teams.
  • Significantly contributes to Halliburton’s Intellectual Property portfolio by delivering innovative and commercially successful solutions.
  • Work across multiple teams located in different countries (Brazil, US, Singapore, India).
  • Work close to the Electrical Engineering team, Systems Engineer, and the Project Manager at the Halliburton Technology Center in Brazil (HBTC).

Qualifications

  • Completion of a master’s or doctoral degree in Electrical Engineering or similar discipline is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • 5 years of experience in R&D.
  • Experience with multidisciplinary teams located in different locations/countries.
  • Experience in design of complex systems solutions including several engineering disciplines for Oil & Gas, mining and/or aerospace industry.
  • Experience in design solutions for subsea applications and well control involving multi disciplines.
  • Experience in design solutions for well intervention applications involving multi disciplines is desirable.
  • Ability to provide guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers as needed.
  • Experience defining requirements and reviewing proposals from third party (manufacturers, vendors, and suppliers).
  • Knowledge of vessels structure and process is desirable.
  • Knowledge and experience in Risk Assessment, FMEA, other reliability tools.
  • Advanced experience with design, simulation, development, implementation, verification, and validation of power electronic based systems/solutions.
  • Troubleshooting of power electronics and proficiency in using lab equipment.
  • Knowledge of communication systems/solutions (data compression and transmission).
  • Advanced working knowledge in electronic circuit design and in commonly used circuit simulators (LTSPICE, PSPICE, etc.) and math tools (Matlab, MathCAD, etc.) applied to embedded systems in harsh environments (O&G, mining or aerospace).
  • Knowledge in power systems demands (Batteries / Recharge / Power management / Passivation / Ramp up / Shut down).
